column1: # Machine-readable half of the skills-resync inventory: what each vendored skill was
# copied from, and the upstream tree hash it was copied at.
# No version directory appears here on purpose. resync.sh resolves upstream from the
# marketplace clone under plugins/marketplaces/ (NOT the install cache, which is frozen for
# disabled plugins), following the source kind the marketplace catalog records. See SKILL.md
# The baseline is a per-skill hash of the upstream skill directory, not a plugin commit sha:
# a commit elsewhere in the plugin no longer reads as "this skill moved". `--hash <dir>`
# prints one. It is rewritten by `resync.sh --apply` on every successful re-vendor.
# Do not hand-edit it: a baseline that lags reports upstream as moved when it has not.
# SKILL.md is the source of truth for *why* a row is here and which protected edits it
# carries. This file is the source of truth for *where* it came from.
